In summary, our research is concerned with

developing a computerized approach for the identification and quantification of individual chemical components of environmental mixtures, and for the assessment of their potential carcinogenic activity.
developing a computer-assisted approach for the assessment of the genetic and carcinogenic activity of complex mixtures.
the development of an approach that may provide an estimate of the potential carcinogenic activity of complex environmental mixures.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the potential for carcinogenic activity of a mixture cannot be assessed from the genetic activity of individual chemical components.
the genetic activity profile approach provides a useful tool to assist in the evaluation of potential genetic toxicity of complex environmental mixtues.
the genetic activity profile approach may provide some useful insight into the potential carcinogenicity and/or mutagenicity of complex environmental mixtres.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the GAP data-base is an effective tool for assessing the potential genetic activity and carcinogenicity of environmental mixtures.

the GAP and ACC data-bases provide a useful approach for assessing the potential genetic activity and carcinogenicity of a complex mixture based on the chemical composition of the mixture and the known genetic activity and/or animal carcinogenicity of its components.
the GAP data-base is a useful tool in the identification of chemicals in complex mixtures with potential carcinogenic activity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the genetic bioassay results for individual chemicals are often not predictive of their potential for causing cancer in the whole organism.
the expanded GAP data-base provides a useful tool in assessing potential carcinogenesis of complex mixtures.
the genetic activity of a substance can be used to predict carcinogenic activity and that this activity may be estimated from the activity of its chemical components.
